finding: Under the stated conditions (the Giza dwell, fully developed speckle, no reference image, no receiver noise, motion coherent for the whole pass at its worst phase), a detection at 95% with 5% false alarms needs, for a smooth Gaussian pattern of room-specific line-of-sight motion, at least 3.02 mm at 0.2 Hz over 279 m^2 (3.03 mm over 4.4 m^2) and 47.3 um at 80 Hz over 279 m^2 (379 um over 4.4 m^2), exactly within the model. Those amplitudes hold for that family only: what the image holds depends on the pattern, and a Gaussian 4 m wide at 0.2 Hz multiplied by a cosine of 4 m period along track holds 39 times the Gaussian's information (489 times for a 1 m period) though nowhere larger; at 0.2 Hz the Gaussian holds only 4.7e-4 of what the most informative pattern inside its envelope could. For every pattern the requirement is on energy (Theorem C): any room-specific motion whose integral of max_t |u_los|^2 over the ground stays below 9.8e-10 m^4 (with Giza's background motion in the reference; 1.7e-8 m^4 without) is excluded, whatever its shape, frequency or time history: an rms of 1.0 um over 1,000 m^2. The bench room's modelled static imprint under the regional microseisms falls short of that energy by 4.6e5 in amplitude (against a Gaussian of its peak and footprint, 8.3e8); its dynamic imprints under a truck over a bump 15 m away for the whole pass, the scattered wave carried unattenuated to the scene's corner, by 0.45 to 3.7 (below 1, not excluded: the room under a 5 m roof), and with the scattered wave counted only within 39 m, by 5.2 to 35: under strong shaking close by the conclusion rests on how far the scattered wave carries, an assumption to measure. A mechanism that only changes the ambient motion's phase (moving the ground by at most twice its amplitude, linear or not) is excluded only while the area it changes stays below 5.5e4 m^2 under the regional microseisms, 11 m^2 at the noisiest stations and 2,131 m^2 under a truck at 80 Hz; the bench room's footprint is 128 m^2, so such a mechanism must show its phase changes spread over that much ground. A corner reflector on the footprint's peak needs 14 um whatever the footprint. These are requirements conditional on the model: they say nothing of routes outside it.
